items.q: Will patients see downtime during the migration?
items.a: No. We stage the new site on a mirror domain, run a full parity QA, then flip DNS with a pre-warmed cache. Real users experience a seamless swap — typical measured downtime is under 30 seconds.

items.q: Do we lose Google rankings after migrating?
items.a: No. Every URL is mapped 1:1 with 301 redirects, metadata and schema are preserved, and we monitor Search Console daily for 90 days post-launch. Zero-loss migrations are the standard, not the exception.

items.q: Which platforms do you migrate from?
items.a: WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Webflow, GoDaddy Builder, Duda, Weebly, HubSpot CMS, Drupal, Joomla, and legacy custom builds. We also handle host-to-host moves and full CMS replatforms.

items.q: How is patient data handled during the transfer?
items.a: Any patient-facing forms, portals, or intake data are handled under a BAA-ready workflow. No PHI is ever exported to unsecured environments; encrypted transfer only.

items.q: How long does a full dermatology site migration take?
items.a: 4–7 weeks for a standard practice, 6–10 weeks for multi-location, and 8–12 weeks for complex EHR-integrated migrations. Fixed weekly milestones and a hard launch date.

items.q: What if my old site is a mess of pages, PDFs, and unused blogs?
items.a: We audit and consolidate. Broken and low-value URLs are redirected to their best match, valuable content is restructured, and duplicate pages are merged — cleaner IA out of a messy source.
